title: Universal Protections & Arbitrariness
goal: State universal human-rights safeguards using aun cuando across subjunctive tenses

items: I can pair aun cuando with the imperfect and present perfect subjunctive for universal legal safeguards.
I can distinguish unaccented aun ('even') in aun cuando from accented aún ('still').
I can use arbitrariness, complaint, and freedom-of-expression vocabulary in C1 prose.
